name: Artillery

modes.label: Test workers and Cloud platform
modes.note: Load-generator workers run as AWS Fargate tasks (or ECS on EC2, Lambda, Azure ACI) created by the Artillery CLI in the CUSTOMER'S OWN AWS/Azure account; the compute is billed by AWS/Azure at their list rates, Artillery bills only the subscription. Fargate worker size 1-16 vCPU / 1-120 GB (default 4 vCPU / 8 GB), --spot for Fargate Spot, ephemeral storage 20-200 GB; ACI 1-4 CPU / 1-16 GB per worker, 12 h per test run. Price as AWS Fargate / Azure ACI, not as an Artillery rate.

plans.name: Free
plans.note: 30 reports/month, 1-month retention, 2 team members, E2E max 25 test cases/report.

plans.name: Team
plans.note: $199/month (20% off annually), 1,000 reports/month, 6-month retention, 8 team members. Limits are soft: sporadic excess tolerated; continuous excess -> degraded service / read-only.

plans.name: Business
plans.note: $499/month (20% off annually), 2,500 reports/month, 18-month retention, unlimited members, no worker or duration limit.

caveats: Public Artillery CLI/Cloud subscription: Free 30 reports/mo, up to 5 workers/test, 30min test; Team $199/mo, 1000 reports, 25 workers, 2h; Business $499/mo, 2500 reports with no stated worker/duration cap. Annual 20% discount.

Distributed test workers run in AWS/Azure; separate underlying compute charges must be verified, not assumed included in dashboard/report subscription. Enterprise security add-ons start $1199/mo, own-account cloud deployment quote.
Null values mean unknown, not free/unlimited. No model-token cost, tax or unverified ancillary charge included.
Native browser/device/task/credit prices with unknown CPU/RAM are deliberately non-priceable. Check regime before interpreting any partial resource estimate.

Azure ACI: a single test run is limited to 12 hours and each worker to 4 CPUs / 16 GB; Azure also rate-limits container-group creates per 5 min / per hour (raise via Azure support). Running on Azure ACI for non-evaluation purposes requires an Artillery subscription.
Enterprise add-ons (SSO, audit logs, MSA, SLAs) from $1,199/month; paid-plan trials via sales; purchasable on AWS Marketplace; invoice billing via sales.
